label: Measuring the error
subgoals: Compute each net's relative error against the golden value
Take the largest as the worst-case error
Check whether the errors share a sign, indicating bias

label: Least-squares scale factor
subgoals: Accumulate the sum of fast times golden values
Accumulate the sum of squared fast values
Divide the two sums to get the scale factor

label: Residual error after calibration
subgoals: Scale each fast value by the fitted factor
Recompute the relative errors against golden
Separate remaining scatter from bias and decide on new patterns
